messages:
rowan: quick thread to pick the observability slice for the console roadmap. Customer asks: route-level cost visibility, a tiny trace hook to link into external tracing, and smarter error grouping. proposing a prioritized "toggle-first" approach: basic dashboards + toggle-able trace sampling + grouped errors.

ika: toggle-first sounds pragmatic. avoids heavy billing infra and still answers customer asks. suggest default sampling 0.25% and a UI estimate before they flip it.

tom: agree. launch acceptance: dashboards live, cost widget with route breakdown and confidence band, trace hook API with example, error grouping reduces noise by >=50% in canary.

priya: runtime work: emit metadata {route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out} on request events; attach header when sampled. Pseudocode: ```if(sampled){ response.headers['x-rw-span']=spanId; emitMetric('trace.forward',{route}) }```

rowan: risk: telemetry blowup. mitigations: low default sampling, cap raw retention to 7d, and show confidence on UI.

ika: canary plan: 5 customers (3 PLG, 1 growth, 1 Dedicated) for 10 days. monitors: token delta, dashboard query latency, error-group FP rate. abort if token delta > 35% or latency p95 > 250ms.

tom: owners: Product=rowan, Runtime=priya, Platform=ika, Docs=tom. ops-bot will post canary alerts. dev estimates: schema change (1d), trace hook (2d), dashboard + aggregation (3d), error grouping (2d) => ~8 dev days parallelized.

rowan: decision: proceed with toggle-first. actions: priya open telemetry PR today; ika create dashboard tickets; tom draft UI copy and confirm tooltip copy for sampling. drop reactions to confirm.

ika: :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup:

tom: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: CANARY SCHEDULED start=1719180000 duration=10d. Will post health checks and token deltas.

rowan: thanks all. Parking-lot: per-tenant billing UI and full span viewer for future release.
